messages:
Marissa (AE): Quick sync — Verity Labs wants to start a 4-week trial next week. Need to confirm data access pattern, success metrics, and any enterprise blockers. Can SEs + security chime in? @Derek @Olga

Derek (SE): Thanks. Two top asks from Verity: (1) sample dataset upload (S3) with PII redaction, (2) VPC peering + optional presigned URL for bulk CSVs. Also they want 99th percentile latency < 600ms for generate calls.

Anika (Solutions): They'll run ~10k requests/day, mix of chat + embeddings. Eval sets planned: 500 prompts for accuracy, 200 prompts for hallucination/robustness.

Ravi (Verity IT): We can provide 5k de-identified records initially. Need a simple redaction checklist from you so we can scrub locally before upload.

Olga (Security): We need the security questionnaire answered. Short-term: encrypted S3 (AES-256), presigned uploads, no cross-account IAM keys. Long-term: VPC peering / PrivateLink.

Derek (SE): Redaction checklist — remove direct identifiers (names, SSNs), PHI IDs, free-text timestamps. Here's a tiny script we often share:

```python
import re
def redact(s):
    s = re.sub(r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b','<SSN>',s)
    s = re.sub(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+ [A-Z][a-z]+\b','<NAME>',s)
    s = re.sub(r'\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b','<DATE>',s)
    return s
```

Use it on CSV text columns. We'll provide a more robust containerized scrubber if they want.

Ben (SRE): For uploads, presigned S3 PUT URLs are easiest. We'll provision a short-lived bucket (retention 30 days), lifecycle to delete after trial. For VPC peering, expect 2–3 day setup from infra.

Marissa (AE): Timeline proposal: Week 0 — data handoff; Week 1 — model onboarding + eval run; Week 2 — customer quality review; Week 3 — performance tuning and final review. Is that feasible?

Derek (SE): Yes. Also need to lock success criteria: a) >=90% pass on accuracy eval (they prefer precision-focused metric), b) hallucination rate <5% on the hallucination set, c) 95th percentile latency <700ms for live chat, d) cost per 1k tokens below target (we'll compute).

Anika (Solutions): Can we add a smoke test: 100 prompt cold-cache sample to validate 95th <700ms before full eval?

Olga (Security): Please send the security questionnaire answers and the signed DPA. For the trial we accept presigned uploads + temporary read-only role; no customer data in debug logs unless customer opts in.

Ravi (Verity IT): OK on presigned + we'll scrub locally. One question: any extra cost for reserved capacity or a trial discount if we bump to a small dedicated pool?

Marissa (AE): Pricing note — for a short trial we can offer a trial credit. If they request Dedicated (reserved) capacity during the trial there is a small weekly fee; @Finance to confirm discounting.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf by Olga (Security) — 1834571420

Olga (Security): Uploaded questionnaire + checklist. Ravi, see section 4 for allowed upload patterns and required column-level hashing.

Ben (SRE): I'll create the short-lived bucket and send presigned PUTs by EOD. Also adding lifecycle rule to delete after 30 days. ETA ~6h.

Derek (SE): I'll drop the evaluation harness and prompt files into the repo: github.com/redwood-inference/verity-evals and share access. SE will run an initial onboarding pass once upload is done.

Marissa (AE): Great — checklist for next steps: 1) Verity to scrub and upload sample by Tue morning; 2) SE to run onboarding and share results by Fri; 3) Security to confirm DPA signed and questionnaire OK. Please confirm when done. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Verity IT): We'll aim to upload Tue morning. Thanks everyone.
